facts.statement: The source title is "Secure Your Future and Retire A Millionaire".
The source URL is https://performancepg.co.uk/.
The source states that Christian Ribeiro is a former pro footballer turned property investor.
The source states that Christian Ribeiro's portfolio is now worth millions.
The source states that Jay Puddy is Christian Ribeiro's business partner and a property developer.
The source states that Christian Ribeiro and Jay Puddy take footballers from pitch to prosperity.
The source states that they help footballers get on the property ladder, build wealth, and secure their future with confidence.
The source states that their goal is to help the reader build a property portfolio that increases the reader's net worth and allows the reader to retire a millionaire.
The source states that Christian Ribeiro and Jay Puddy have more than 25 years of combined experience buying, developing, and managing more than 600 properties for their clients.
The source invites the reader to click the button below to book a call with them and see how they can help the reader retire wealthy.
The source offers an alternative link to download a free video series titled "5 Ways To Win With Your Wealth Off-Pitch".
The source describes the video series as the perfect introduction to the world of property investing.
The source states that finding the perfect career after playing the field as a professional footballer can be really challenging and confusing.
The source states that Christian Ribeiro retired at the age of 27 due to a knee injury.
The source states that when Christian Ribeiro retired, he did not have any additional skills he could fall back on.
The source states that Christian Ribeiro's biggest worry was that he would end up in a dead-end job, struggling to make ends meet and having to downgrade his lifestyle substantially.

The source states that it is an all-too-common problem among football players to end up in financial ruin and endless personal problems if they do not have a career path they can confidently get into.
The source states that property investing is one of the best ways to secure your income without having to sacrifice your lifestyle or end up in a job you hate.
The source states that with their complete, done-for-you service, the reader can focus on levelling up their game while they handle everything from start to finish.
The source states that it is hard to win when you are not playing as a team.
The source states that you can sleep easy knowing they have got you covered.
